name: Vector Icon Volume Rendering
aliases: Vector Icon Splatting with Billboard Textures
Vector icons embedded in splat footprint
Volume Rendering with Embedded Vector Icons
definition: A 3D raster resampling technique where volume rendering is built up in sheets, with tiny cylinders (vector icons) stochastically placed within splats to indicate flow direction.
summary: Vector Icon Volume Rendering integrates vector field visualization into scalar volume rendering by embedding billboard icons within splat footprints, distinguishing itself by maintaining volumetric context while indicating flow direction and magnitude.
